description: Sui Northern Gas Pipelines Limited was incorporated as a private limited company in 1963 and converted into a public limited company in January 1964; it is listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange. It took over the existing Sui-Multan system from the Pakistan Industrial Development Corporation and the Dhulian-Rawalpindi-Wah system from Attock Oil Company Limited, and describes itself as the largest integrated gas company, serving more than 7.40 million consumers in Punjab, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Azad Jammu & Kashmir.
